info.name: Qlik Cloud REST Apps Reloads API

params.name: appId
params.description: The identifier of the app to list reloads for.

params.name: filter
params.description: SCIM filter expression for advanced filtering of reload records.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of reload records to return.

params.name: log
params.description: When true, includes the script log in the response.

params.name: next
params.description: Cursor for the next page of results.

params.name: prev
params.description: Cursor for the previous page of results.

params.name: partial
params.description: When true, returns partial reload information.

items.docs: Finds and returns reload records for a specific app. The appId query parameter is required.
Triggers a reload of an app to refresh its data from connected sources. Rate limited to 50 requests per minute.

params.name: reloadId
params.description: The unique identifier of the reload.

items.docs: Retrieves a specific reload record by its identifier.

params.name: reloadId
params.description: The unique identifier of the reload.

items.docs: Cancels a queued or in-progress reload. Rate limited to 50 requests per minute.
